# OPUS at UTS

> OPUS at UTS is the University of Technology Sydney's institutional repository for open access scholarly publications, research outputs, and ERA submissions.

OPUS at UTS serves as a centralized platform for UTS researchers to deposit and share their scholarly work, featuring collections organized by faculties, research centers, and institutes. The repository supports open access publishing, copyright management, and research impact metrics across the university's academic divisions.

## Getting Started

- [OPUS at UTS: Home](https://opus.lib.uts.edu.au): OPUS at UTS homepage: institutional repository for open access scholarly publications
- [How to Deposit](https://opus.lib.uts.edu.au/help/deposit): Step-by-step guide for depositing research and ERA submissions to OPUS
- [Managing Copyright](https://opus.lib.uts.edu.au/help/copyright): Copyright management, Creative Commons licenses, and author rights guidance
- [Copyright Policy](https://opus.lib.uts.edu.au/help/about): Copyright policy and open access guidelines for OPUS at UTS researchers

## Research Collections & Centers

- [Office of DVC (Research)](https://opus.lib.uts.edu.au/handle/10453/35348): DVC Research office publications and university research outputs collection
- [Connected Intelligence Centre](https://opus.lib.uts.edu.au/handle/10453/41322): Connected Intelligence Centre research publications on learning analytics
- [Institute for Sustainable Futures](https://opus.lib.uts.edu.au/handle/10453/35354): Institute for Sustainable Futures publications on water, climate, and health
- [Institute for Public Policy and Governance](https://opus.lib.uts.edu.au/handle/10453/52692): Institute for Public Policy and Governance research on health and evaluation
- [Centre for Local Government](https://opus.lib.uts.edu.au/handle/10453/35353): Centre for Local Government research on urban planning and governance
- [Divisions & Centres](https://opus.lib.uts.edu.au/handle/10453/37691): UTS divisions and research centres collection in OPUS repository

## Organizational Collections

- [UTS Organisational Groups](https://opus.lib.uts.edu.au/community-list): Directory of UTS faculties and departments within OPUS repository structure
- [DVC (Education and Students)](https://opus.lib.uts.edu.au/handle/10453/41320): DVC Education and Students research collection featuring learning analytics
- [Office of the Provost](https://opus.lib.uts.edu.au/handle/10453/35351): Office of the Provost research collection on mental health and youth homelessness

## General Collections

- [General Collection - Education and Engineering](https://opus.lib.uts.edu.au/handle/10453/35359): General collection of scholarly publications across education and engineering
- [General Collection - Hydrology and Climate](https://opus.lib.uts.edu.au/handle/10453/35355): Research collection covering hydrology, climate science, and academic spin-offs
- [General Collection - Mental Health and Business](https://opus.lib.uts.edu.au/handle/10453/35360): General collection featuring mental health research and business education

## Repository Analytics

- [Statistical Summary](https://opus.lib.uts.edu.au/statistics): Repository analytics and publication metrics for OPUS at UTS collections
